Private uint256 battle counter initialised to 1, incremented in reset().
Private uint256 minimum price in wei required to buy a country.

Private uint256 index of the winning country; 6 means no winner yet.

Private mapping(uint256 => address) of battle id to winning address.
Private mapping(uint256 => uint8) of battle id to winning item id.
Caller-controlled address used as owner, buyer, country owner and transfer recipient.
Block timestamp (now) consumed inside sha() as randomness entropy.
withdrawAll(): msg.sender.transfer(this.balance) drains the whole contract balance to the owner.
withdrawAmount(): msg.sender.transfer(_amount) sends an owner-chosen amount out of the contract.
calculateWin(): winAddress.transfer(reward) external value transfer executed before history bookkeeping.
getRandom()/sha() derive the winner from block.number, blockhash, block.difficulty, block.coinbase, now and a counter, which is miner-influenceable and predictable.
isContract(): inline assembly extcodesize(addr) used as an anti-contract check that fails for constructors and can be bypassed.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, making the caller the privileged account.
Constructor writes the price state variable from the _price argument.
Constructor initialises the privileged owner state variable.
onlyOwner modifier requires owner == msg.sender before withdrawAll runs.
onlyOwner modifier gates withdrawAmount on the stored owner.
withdrawAll executes msg.sender.transfer(this.balance).
withdrawAmount executes msg.sender.transfer(_amount).
The caller address receives the entire drained contract balance.
The caller address receives the requested withdrawal amount.
msg.sender is recorded as the country owner and must be non-zero and a non-contract.
buyCountry writes countryOwners[countryId] = msg.sender.
buyCountry relies on slot emptiness checks consistent with isBuyFull state.
buyCountry requires !isContract(msg.sender), a weak anti-bot access check.
isContract performs inline assembly extcodesize(addr).
onlyOwner gates the calculateWin payout routine.
onlyOwner gates the reset state-clearing routine.
calculateWin requires isBuyFull() before drawing a winner.
calculateWin calls getRandom to select the winning country index.
getRandom calls sha to build the pseudo-random value.
getRandom returns the modulo index that becomes the win state.
calculateWin assigns win = getRandom(battleCount, countryOwners.length).
calculateWin performs the external value transfer winAddress.transfer(reward).
addHistory state updates execute only after the external transfer returns.
Winner address and reward from the transfer path feed the history bookkeeping call.
sha() consumes now (block.timestamp) as entropy, creating timestamp dependence.
block.timestamp feeds the miner-influenceable randomness used for the payout decision.
getRandom implements the predictable block-data based winner selection.
reset sets win back to 6 (no winner).
reset increments the battleCount state variable.
reset deletes every entry of countryOwners.
ownerOfCountryCount validates the caller-supplied _owner against address(0).
countryId bounds-checked and used to index countryOwners in buyCountry.
_battleId keys the history mappings written by addHistory.
addHistory writes winAddressHistory[_battleId].
addHistory writes winItemIdHistory[_battleId].
addHistory increments the historyCount state variable.
addressHistoryOf reads winAddressHistory[_battleId].
itemHistoryOf reads winItemIdHistory[_battleId].
getHistory loops over addressHistoryOf for each battle id.
getHistory loops over itemHistoryOf for each battle id.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor parameter only used to initialise the price state variable.
Withdrawal amount parameter consumed only by the msg.sender.transfer call.
Address parameter only used for the non-zero require and array comparison loop.
Slot index parameter used solely to index countryOwners inside buyCountry.
Counter parameter folded into the hash input computation of getRandom.
Modulus parameter used only in the return expression of getRandom.
Entropy parameter forwarded directly into the keccak256 argument list.
Previous blockhash parameter hashed inside sha and returned.
Address parameter inspected only by extcodesize in the asm block.
Battle id parameter used only as the mapping key in addHistory and history views.
Winner address parameter stored into winAddressHistory.
Item id parameter stored into winItemIdHistory.
Range lower bound parameter driving the getHistory loop.
Range upper bound parameter used only for the historyCount require and length computation.
Returned index local fully contained in the winAddressOf return logic.
Returned winner address local fully contained in winAddressOf.
Accumulator local used exclusively by ownerOfCountryCount.
Loop counter local used only by the getHistory iteration.
Local winner address is the direct recipient of the reward transfer.
Local reward amount is the value moved by the winAddress.transfer call.
Intermediate block number local used only to fetch the prior blockhash.
Intermediate blockhash local handed to sha().
Truncated hash-plus-count local used only as sha input.
Result local of getRandom, returned after the modulo limit.
Local holding the extcodesize result inside isContract.
Allocated array length local driving the history loop.
Local item id returned directly by itemHistoryOf.
Echoed min battle id local returned by getHistory.
Local address read from the history mapping and returned.
